title: Turn Instagram Engagement into a Lead List
summary: People who like and comment on your posts are warm. Shortlist the ones who fit your ideal customer.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already sell on Instagram; it adds warm conversations, not a new product.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: More conversations with people who already know your brand.
Less time scrolling through likes to find buyers.
who_its_for: Coaches, consultants and small brands that sell through Instagram.

stack.name: Engagement Lead Finder
stack.role: Reviews who engages with your posts and shortlists people who match your ideal customer.
stack.creator: aferrari

steps.name: Engagement Lead Finder
steps.does: Reviews who engages and scores the fit

steps.name: You
steps.does: Reach out by hand to the best matches

steps: Add the bot and describe your ideal customer in a few lines.
Connect the Instagram account you post from.
Review the first shortlist and correct anything it got wrong.
Reach out by hand to the best matches.
guardrails: Stay within Instagram's rules on messaging.
